note: Every URL below was fetched during development and the observed HTTP status recorded. 'redistributable' records whether the source's own terms allow bundling its content inside this app.

records.title: WHO Child Growth Standards — weight-for-age and length/height-for-age expanded z-score tables (0–5 years, per day, L/M/S)
records.claim_scope: International growth reference for 0–60 months. NOT a national ranking for China or Singapore, and not a diagnosis.
records.license: WHO website terms of use: reproduction permitted for research/private study and educational or other non-commercial purposes, with acknowledgement of WHO and the source URL. Commercial use requires prior written authorization.
records.attribution: World Health Organization, WHO Child Growth Standards (2006). Tables retrieved from cdn.who.int on 2026-10-26.
records.verification_note: All four official .xlsx tables downloaded (HTTP 200). L/M/S parsed for days 0–1157. Our LMS implementation reproduces WHO's own printed SD0/SD±2/SD±3 columns to within 0.0005, i.e. WHO's print rounding. This is a programmatic reproduction check, NOT a clinical review.

records.title: WHO anthro R package — official reference implementation of the LMS z-score and the ±3 SD flat adjustment
records.claim_scope: Algorithm only. Defines z = ((Y/M)^L - 1)/(S*L) and the linear flat adjustment beyond ±3 SD applied to weight-based (right-skewed) indicators. Length/height-for-age is modelled as normal and receives no adjustment.
records.license: GPL-3.0 (source code). Used here as an algorithm specification; no WHO code is copied into this app.
records.attribution: Algorithm per WHO anthro reference implementation.
records.verification_note: WHO's software page links this package as reflecting the recommended methodology. The legacy Chap_7.pdf URL it cites now returns 404 and could not be read directly.

records.title: WHO Guideline for complementary feeding of infants and young children 6–23 months of age
records.claim_scope: Normative global recommendations on complementary feeding. Provides stage-level principles, NOT per-ingredient age thresholds.
records.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO (as displayed on the WHO publication landing page).
records.attribution: WHO Guideline for complementary feeding of infants and young children 6–23 months of age. Geneva: World Health Organization; 2023.
records.verification_note: BLOCKED: only the landing page (HTTP 200) could be read. The full-text PDF is hosted on iris.who.int, which was unreachable from the build environment (all TCP attempts failed). The numbered recommendations were therefore NOT transcribed and no rule in this app claims to implement them.

records.title: Infant and young child feeding — fact sheet
records.claim_scope: General principle only: complementary foods introduced from 6 months alongside continued breastfeeding to 2 years or beyond. Does not establish suitability of any individual ingredient.
records.license: WHO website terms of use (non-commercial, with acknowledgement).
records.attribution: WHO infant and young child feeding fact sheet.
records.verification_note: Fetched successfully (HTTP 200). Used only as the stated general-principle basis for the app's 6-month framing text; never as a per-ingredient age source.

records.claim_scope: Food composition for the US food supply. NOT validated against Chinese or Singaporean foods, preparation methods or edible-portion conventions.

Energy estimation therefore stays disabled rather than producing unfounded numbers.
